name: 37-filter-opacity
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { margin: 8px 0; padding: 6px; font-size: 15px; background-color: #3366cc; color: #fff; } .blur { filter: blur(2px); } .gray { filter: grayscale(100%); } .sep { filter: sepia(0.6); } .op { opacity: 0.4; } .both { opacity: 0.7; filter: sepia(0.6); }
html:
blur 2px 模糊
grayscale 100% 去色
sepia 0.6 怀旧
opacity 0.4 半透明
opacity 与 filter 叠加
